'''June 2001 Albany tournament (2 June)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held at Gamers Guild, Albany, NY on 2 June 2001. [[Chris Terwilliger]] won it. It is known from Matt Sokol's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2420">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-07-albany-ny-june-2ndd2420/ albany-ny-june-2nd], DeckTech (Matt "MattSokol" Sokol, 7 June 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-07-albany-ny-june-2ndd2420/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 2 June 2001
* '''Site:''' Gamers Guild, Albany, NY
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Tatooine]]
* '''Players:''' 25
* '''Winner:''' [[Chris Terwilliger]]
